body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fills documentation gaps by adding reference docs for the QA testing protocol, contracts layer, and two AI protocols (DevOps Agent and Feedback Loop), and wires them into the main reference index.

**Changes:**
- Added a new QA protocol section (index + Testing reference) describing `TestSuite`, `TestScenario`, `TestStep`, actions, assertions, and context usage.
- Introduced a Contracts section with per-interface pages (data engine, logger, HTTP server, plugin validator, schema driver, service registry, lifecycle events, startup orchestrator) and linked it from the global reference index.
- Documented the AI DevOps Agent and Feedback Loop schemas with TypeScript usage examples and use cases, and updated the global reference index counts and navigation.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 16 out of 16 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `content/docs/references/qa/testing.mdx` | New QA Testing protocol reference describing `TestContext`, action/assertion enums, and `TestSuite`/`TestScenario`/`TestStep` structures, aligned with `packages/spec/src/qa/testing.zod.ts`. |
| `content/docs/references/qa/meta.json` | Registers QA reference pages (`index`, `testing`) for the docs navigation. |
| `content/docs/references/qa/index.mdx` | QA protocol overview page summarizing capabilities and linking to the Testing reference. |
| `content/docs/references/index.mdx` | Updates protocol index with QA and Contracts sections, increases total protocol count, and adds a table for contract interfaces (note: currently mislabels `Logger` and `IHttpServer` names). |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/data-engine.mdx` | Detailed docs for `IDataEngine` and `DriverInterface`, including method-by-method explanations and examples matching `data-engine.ts`. |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/http-server.mdx` | Overview of the HTTP server contract (`IHttpRequest`, `IHttpResponse`, `RouteHandler`, `Middleware`, `IHttpServer`) with correct source pointer. |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/index.mdx` | Contracts overview explaining the concept of contracts vs Zod schemas and linking to all individual contract pages. |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/logger.mdx` | Logger contract reference with a TypeScript example (currently imports/implements `ILogger` instead of the actual `Logger` interface). |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/meta.json` | Contracts section metadata listing all contract pages for the sidebar/navigation. |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/plugin-lifecycle-events.mdx` | High-level description of plugin lifecycle event interfaces, tied to `plugin-lifecycle-events.ts`. |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/plugin-validator.mdx` | Extensive Plugin Validator docs and examples (currently out of sync with `IPluginValidator` regarding `validateSignature` signature and missing `validateDependencies` in example implementations). |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/schema-driver.mdx` | Schema driver contract overview for DDL/migration operations. |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/service-registry.mdx` | Service registry contract overview for registering and resolving services. |
| `content/docs/references/contracts/startup-orchestrator.mdx` | Startup orchestrator contract overview for plugin startup ordering and health-check orchestration. |
| `content/docs/references/ai/feedback-loop.mdx` | Feedback Loop protocol reference for runtime issues and AI-driven resolutions, with examples (one `changeSet` example does not match the actual `ChangeSetSchema` shape). |
| `content/docs/references/ai/devops-agent.mdx` | DevOps Agent protocol reference describing configuration for codegen, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, and integrations, broadly consistent with `devops-agent.zod.ts`. |
</details>

This method reference documents `validateSignature(plugin: Plugin, signature: string): boolean`, but `IPluginValidator` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/plugin-validator.ts` defines `validateSignature?(plugin: Plugin): Promise<boolean>` with a single `plugin` parameter. Please align this signature and return type with the actual interface (async, single parameter) or adjust the interface if the two-argument sync form is what you intend to expose.

The `Contracts` overview table lists interface names `ILogger` and `IHTTPServer`, but the actual interfaces in `packages/spec/src/contracts/logger.ts` and `http-server.ts` are named `Logger` and `IHttpServer` respectively. Please update these interface names in the table to match the real contract types so the docs stay consistent with the code.
```suggestion
| `logger.ts` | `Logger` | Logging interface |
| `http-server.ts` | `IHttpServer` | HTTP server interface |
```

The `MyPluginValidator` example omits the required `validateDependencies(plugin: Plugin, registry: Map<string, Plugin>): void` method from the `IPluginValidator` contract in `packages/spec/src/contracts/plugin-validator.ts`, so the class as written would not satisfy the interface. Consider adding a minimal `validateDependencies` implementation (or clearly marking it as omitted) to keep the example type-correct.
